# Renderd

> Renderd is a free, open-source app that turns a Windows PC into a second monitor for a Mac, peer to peer on your local network.

The Mac (Apple Silicon, macOS 13 or later) runs the host, which makes a real extra display and streams it as hardware-encoded HEVC or H.264 over QUIC. The Windows 10 or 11 PC (x64 or ARM64) runs the viewer, which decodes it on the GPU and shows it. Pairing uses a six-digit PIN and SPAKE2+. There is no account, no cloud and no relay server. MIT licence, written in Rust.

## Pages

- [Home](https://renderd.xyz/): what Renderd does, how a frame travels, limits, security, other tools compared, FAQ
- [Download](https://renderd.xyz/download/): files, checksums, requirements and the first run, step by step
